## Make the assumption inspectable
### Keep the explanation readable, and expand the evidence when needed

::: {.canvas src="canvas.html" title="Illustrative pilot scenarios" interactive="true"}
:::

::: takeaway
Test the assumption before deciding whether to expand.
:::

## Keep the document a document

The reading view should retain normal prose, flexible-height evidence, and a
conclusion next to the argument. It should not become a stack of slide boxes.

::: takeaway
Use one meaning, with a layout appropriate to each output.
:::
